domain.title: Kidney Health, Hydration & Electrolytes
domain.outcome: Explain fluid and electrolyte physiology without universal targets or unsafe personalized replacement plans.
coverageGaps: Acquire topic-specific authoritative sources and qualified reviews; no scientific evidence ingested.

modules.title: Kidney Health, Hydration & Electrolytes — Foundation
modules.assessment: Define the concepts, distinguish common misconceptions and identify what requires clinical evaluation.
modules.completionGate: Topic dossiers appraised; domain and evidence reviewers accept the case assessment; clinical reviewer accepts scope and health claims.

modules.title: Kidney Health, Hydration & Electrolytes — Mastery

modules.completionGate: Topic dossiers appraised; domain and evidence reviewers accept the case assessment; clinical reviewer accepts scope and health claims.

modules.title: Kidney Health, Hydration & Electrolytes — Advanced
